Horizontal curve radius R = V²/[127(e+f)] = 60²/[127x(0.06+0.15)] = 3600/[127x0.21] = 3600/26.67 = 135.0 m.
Code minimum radius (60 km/h) = 125 m, R=135 >= 125 → satisfied.
Circular curve length Lc = R·α(rad) = 135.0x(60xπ/180) = 135.0x1.0472 = 141.4 m.
Transition curve length Ls = B·e·p = 7.5x0.06x125 = 56.2 m.
Tangent length T = R·tan(α/2)+Ls/2 = 135xtan30°+28.1 = 77.9+28.1 = 106.1 m; external distance E = 21.9 m.
Total curve length = Lc+2Ls = 141.4+112.4 = 253.9 m.
map.超高率 e 和横向力系数 f 怎么取？: How are the superelevation rate e and lateral friction factor f chosen?
map.e 一般取 2%~10%（不超过最大超高，如 8%~10% 依地区冰冻条件），f: e is typically 2%-10% (not exceeding the maximum superelevation, such as 8%-10% depending on regional icing conditions), and f is the lateral friction factor acceptable to passengers (usually 0.10-0.15). The larger both are, the smaller the required radius, but excessive e hurts drainage and excessive f makes passengers uncomfortable, so choose a balanced value per the code.
